attributes.name: Shamira
attributes.powers:
Shamira cannot be evaded and is immune to the Electricity, Fire, Mental, and Poison traits.

If undefeated, discard 1d4+2 cards from the blessings deck. Characters may expend any number of mythic charges to reduce the number of cards by 1 for each charge expended.
